description_en: Creates and adds tags. You can call the TagResources operation to uniformly create and attach tags to your Auto Scaling resources, streamlining resource management. This capability empowers you to categorize resources based on tags, thereby enhancing the overall efficiency of resource allocation and utilization
description_zh: 调用API TagResources为指定的弹性伸缩资源列表统一创建并绑定标签，可以帮助您更好地管理和分类资源，通过标签了解资源使用情况，提高资源利用率
kebab_example: aliyun ess tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --resource-ids asg-2zej7nf7hea77k5a0000 --tags Value=TestValue Propagate=false Key=TestKey --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to scalinggroup
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义，目前仅支持伸缩组。取值：scalinggroup
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Auto Scaling resources. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_ids

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

You cannot specify an empty string as a tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to propagate the tag that you want to add. Valid values:

true: propagates the tag to new instances.
false: does not propagate the tag to any instance.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
标识该标签是否为可传播标签，取值范围：
true：伸缩组上的标签只会传播到新创建的实例上，而不会传播到已经在伸缩组中运行的实例上。
false：伸缩组上的标签不会传播到实例上。

默认值：false
fields.name: propagate

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

You can specify empty strings as tag values. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to add to the Auto Scaling resources
parameters.name: tags
